description.value: Jags is a family-run guest house and coffee shop in Skidegate on Haida Gwaii, grown from a garden shop started in 1996 into a 12-room oceanfront property with a full espresso bar and daily-fresh baking. The coffee shop is a local institution — reviewers describe it as the best cup of coffee for miles, with ocean views and house-made cinnamon buns reportedly worth the trip on their own. For touring cyclists reaching Haida Gwaii by ferry, it sits directly on BC-16 and serves as a natural refuelling stop with a breakfast menu running all morning.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at stayatjags.com is fully operational and describes a family-owned guest house and coffee shop called 'Jags' at #100, BC-16, Skidegate, BC V0T 1S1 — the OSM record names it 'Jags Beanstalk' but no trace of 'Beanstalk' appears anywhere on the website, which is a material name discrepancy worth flagging. The coffee shop menu explicitly lists oat, almond, and soy milk alternatives and almond flour cookies, confirming vegan and likely GF options; however, no bike parking, water refill, washroom access, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. The address was taken from the website footer as OSM carries no address field.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Jags Beanstalk' but the website uses only 'Jags' throughout — no mention of 'Beanstalk' anywhere on the site. The OSM name may be outdated or incorrect.
No phone number present in either OSM tags or website content.
OSM tags the property only as a cafe (amenity=cafe) but the business is equally an accommodation (12 guest rooms); the category is correct for this directory but the OSM record is incomplete.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating coffee shop and guest house on a main cycling route through Haida Gwaii; website is active and bookings are open. A clear stop for touring cyclists arriving by ferry to Skidegate.
enrichment_extras.notes: The coffee shop is Monday–Friday only; closed weekends and holidays per the website. Guests are directed to the nearby co-op grocery when the coffee shop is closed. Luggage storage and guest laundry are available for accommodation guests.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly offers oat, almond, and soy milk alternatives (+$1) for all espresso drinks; 'Almond Flour Chocolate Chip' cookies listed, suggesting GF baking options. Egg-based breakfast items indicate vegetarian choices throughout
